scope.owner_policy: Suppress Telegram messages solely about original idea TTL expiry. Preserve OBSERVE/confirmedENTRY and task expiry/price cancellation rules. Never rewrite prior SENT bytes.

initial_findings.resolution: Known unsent TTL receipt is identified from already selected row before lifecycle/binding lookup. Reconciler marks FAILED_FINAL and processes remaining rows; bound sidecar selects bounded existing message_hash and suppresses before load. No new query, no SENT state selected.

initial_findings.scope: silent TTL lifecycle closure and zero ACK
trace: prepareOriginalIdeaTerminal selector includes expired task with life OBSERVE
lifecycle UPDATE NOT EXISTS any same-wave IDEA_REMOVED dispatch -> zero changes
new if(expired) returns immediately with lifecycle_closed=false
existing dispatch may become FAILED_FINAL but NOT EXISTS still false
same unclosed expired task remains selectable ahead of other task during original bounded selection window
initial_findings.effect: silent closure not achieved and terminal scan can repeatedly stop on zero ACK; dispatch SENT bytes need not change
initial_findings.resolution: Expired lifecycle update uses1=1 instead of any-dispatch exclusion; price cancellation preserves original NOT EXISTS. Zero changes continues existing two-task scan; unknown ACK is explicitly not closed. No new TTL dispatch inserted.

final_code_reasoning.claim: New TTL expiry is silent and closes lifecycle
final_code_reasoning.basis: Existing task selector/canonical identity/expiry/cancel predicates retained. Only EXPIRED path omits dispatch INSERT and removes dispatch-existence veto from lifecycle UPDATE. Zero ACK scans next selected task; unknown ACK reports not-closed. Price cancellation retains guarded UPDATE+INSERT and original receipt fields.

final_code_reasoning.claim: Known unsent TTL backlog terminates before missing lifecycle/publication can cause a retry loop
final_code_reasoning.basis: Pure matcher requires PENDING/FAILED_RETRYABLE +IDEA_REMOVED +bounded parsed removal receipt +ORIGINAL_TTL_EXPIRED +same contract/direction/wave. Selected silent rows get FAILED_FINAL before exactPublicationForDispatch; remaining ENTRY/OBSERVE rows continue within the original bounded query result. No prior read/canonical persistence for matched TTL.

final_code_reasoning.claim: Known bound TTL rows cannot occupy retry slots repeatedly or reach network
final_code_reasoning.basis: The existing selected-row query adds bounded message_hash projection; no extra SQL query. Matcher runs before binding/publication loading; unsent TTL becomes FAILED_FINAL and is absent from next pending selection. Existing max_reconcile4/max_lifecycle2/envelope and ACK/network/claim functions remain. A usageSnapshot-only guard after terminal preparation stops before further work if the unchanged delivery envelope is exceeded; it adds no SQL and does not grant headroom.

final_code_reasoning.claim: Canonical policy refuses TTL in both finalize actionability and bound load
final_code_reasoning.basis: Only IDEA_REMOVED with lifecycle_removal.reason ORIGINAL_TTL_EXPIRED receives OWNER_TTL_NOTICE_DISABLED. Existing OBSERVE/WAIT/ENTRY gates are not relaxed. Bound TTL refusal occurs before prior-delivery query/network; valid cancellation reasons preserve existing route.

final_code_reasoning.claim: Diagnostic projection does not acquire or authorize trading
final_code_reasoning.basis: Pure helper bounds last_result to16384 code units, projects only retained identity-bound input and at most8 retained light rows. Source/observed/checked clock checks and original task identity are preserved. History is always incomplete, actual_ENTRY null, entry_authorized false, SQL/sourceHTTP0. projectFollowup catches projection failures after existing writes; no trading predicate depends on diagnostic output.

final_code_reasoning.claim: Both new policy/diagnostic modules are copied
final_code_reasoning.basis: Overlay includes original-task-followup-audit.mjs and owner-telegram-expiry-policy.mjs. The same working overlay also contains source integration additions; those additions and their runtime behavior are outside this code peer.

immutability_and_authority.basis: Known-TTL matcher excludes SENT; reconciliation mark only PENDING/FAILED_RETRYABLE, network setState receives pending-selected rows and SQL excludes SENT. No old publication text/message_hash/Telegram message-id rewrite is added. Lifecycle close is internal; historical expiry messages remain historical.

limits_ru: Статический peer конкретных сохранённых bytes. Новых unit/app/проб не было. Общую affected/cloud проверку и интеграцию выполняет координатор.

Контрпримеры — точные входные формы и трассы кода, не утверждение о наличии таких строк в production. По финальным bytes обе переданные проблемы закрыты; production queue readback здесь не выполнялся.

Диагностика отражает только уже выбранный и прошедший старый parser/identity task перед terminal writes. Она не восстанавливает все LIGHT, задачи вне selector, пропавшие/invalid original replies, цены или первую причину отказа всей цепочки. История явно неполная, UNKNOWN сохраняется.
16K ограничение helper задано в UTF-16 code units; bounded SQL message_hash expression — длинаSQLite text. Это не доказательство native wire/heap/body/day budget.
Общий source512+515/Bitfinex compact consumer/formatter, текущие105/nativecache/cost/delivery и старые принятые проверки этим peer не квалифицированы.
Receipt относится к точному snapshot ZIP и listed SHA; более поздние кодовые изменения требуют проверки только нового delta.
